dossier.purpose: Documentation-only repository (no executable code) that ships one Agent Skill, `typesafe-ai` (skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md, 149 lines), packaged as Claude Code plugin 'typesafe' in a one-plugin marketplace named 'typesafe-ai' (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). The skill teaches a coding agent to design and compose software around TypeSafe AI's 'System One' models (e.g. Jev), which return typed answers and probabilities through Choice/Noul/Score primitives (SKILL.md:18-24, 99-103), and tells the agent to read live docs at docs.typesafe.ai for API/SDK details (SKILL.md:26-53). Its subject is one vendor's API. The repo contains no general engineering or security procedure set (the only security-related sentence is 'Keep API credentials server-side in web apps', SKILL.md:149), no evaluation framework or scorers, no containerized Claude Code/Codex runner, and no CI regression gate.

claims.claim: Positioned as 'Agent skills for building with TypeSafe: typed decisions and probabilities from System One models.'
Claude Code install is two terminal commands: `claude plugin marketplace add typesafe-ai/skills`, then `claude plugin install typesafe@typesafe-ai`.
Other agents install via skills.sh: `npx skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai`; 'Select your agent when prompted.' No agent is named.
'Installation is project-local by default; add `-g` to install globally.'
An installation guide at docs.typesafe.ai/agent-skill#installation provides 'a prompt to copy to your agent, manual installation, and updates'.

Usage is by natural-language request (example: 'Use TypeSafe to route incoming support tickets by department, with human review for uncertain decisions.'); in Claude Code the skill can be invoked explicitly with `/typesafe:typesafe-ai`.
The skills table has a single row: `typesafe-ai` - 'Design TypeSafe workflows, find current docs and cookbooks, and compose typed judgments in code'.
SKILL.md can be read on GitHub or fetched as raw Markdown from raw.githubusercontent.com (main branch, skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md).

Absent from the README (whole 42-line file read): supported OS/architectures, Codex or any named non-Claude agent, MCP, telemetry or network behavior, accounts/pricing for the TypeSafe service, tests/CI, evaluation, benchmarks.

code.architecture: No binary, CLI module or server main exists. Six tracked files (the working tree also holds an untracked .round-meta.json written by the harness, not upstream): README.md, LICENSE, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md, skills/typesafe-ai/LICENSE. Chain: marketplace 'typesafe-ai' -> one plugin 'typesafe' (source './', marketplace.json:8-13) -> one skill 'typesafe-ai'. SKILL.md has front matter with only name, license and description (lines 1-14; the 'use when' trigger text is at lines 8-10; no allowed-tools). Body: intro (16-24); 'Read the live docs' with a task-to-docs table linking 24 distinct docs.typesafe.ai pages (26-53); 'Find the useful shape' patterns (55-93); 'Design the judgments' covering the Choice/Noul/Score primitives (95-121); 'Compose and verify' covering composition, confidence and testing advice (123-149). The repo has no hooks, commands, agents, MCP/LSP config, scripts, references/ or assets/ directories, so the plugin contributes instruction text only; the detailed procedures sit on the external docs site. The skill itself advises 'targeted reads rather than loading the entire site' (SKILL.md:32-33). Its verification content ('citation checks', SKILL.md:83-86) concerns applications built on the TypeSafe API, not evaluation tooling for prompts, skills or agents.
code.packaging_and_release: No release workflow, build step, artifacts, checksums, signatures or attestations (no .github/ directory; the six tracked files are all Markdown/JSON/LICENSE). Distribution is by source: the marketplace entry's source is './' (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:12), i.e. the repo itself, and the skills.sh install names the GitHub repo (README.md:21). The marketplace entry carries no version, ref or sha pin (marketplace.json:9-13). Version 0.5.7 is declared only in .claude-plugin/plugin.json:3. The local clone has a lightweight tag v0.5.7 (.git/refs/tags/v0.5.7:1) at the same commit 65a39f3 (the task's revision lists tag null), and the session's git-status snapshot gives the latest commit message as 'Release v0.5.7' (not a file I opened). The clone is shallow (.git/shallow:1), so earlier history and the commit date are not available.

risks: Scope: the repo ships exactly one skill, about building with TypeSafe's API (README.md:36-38; SKILL.md:16-24; six tracked files). It has no general engineering or security procedures (the only security-related sentence is SKILL.md:149), no evaluation framework or scorers, no containerized agent-CLI runner and no CI regression gate (SKILL.md:145-149 is advice only).

Remote instructions: SKILL.md:28 calls the live docs at docs.typesafe.ai 'the source of truth' and directs the agent to fetch the llms.txt index and '.md' pages (SKILL.md:32-37; 24 distinct page URLs). That content is outside this repo, unpinned and unchecksummed, so agent behavior can change without a commit here; the offline fallback is to state the limitation (SKILL.md:41-44).

External service coupling: the skill steers designs toward TypeSafe's HTTP API and Python/JavaScript SDKs (SKILL.md:52, 95-117) and mentions API credentials (SKILL.md:149) and token/request cost (SKILL.md:129-130). Sign-up, pricing, data handling and terms are not documented in the repo.

Platform and agent support is under-documented: no OS, architecture or GPU statement (README.md:7-26); Codex is not named anywhere in the repo; non-Claude installs go through the external `npx skills` CLI (README.md:18-24), whose supported agents, network use and telemetry are not covered here and were not inspected.

Maintenance and provenance signals: no CI, tests, release workflow, SECURITY policy, changelog, checksums, signatures or attestations (six tracked files); the marketplace entry has no version, ref or sha pin (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:9-13); the version appears only in .claude-plugin/plugin.json:3 and a lightweight tag v0.5.7. The shallow clone (.git/shallow:1) exposes only the HEAD commit, so history and commit date could not be determined.

Activation breadth: the skill's description says to use it 'when brainstorming what AI could make possible in an app' or when 'an LLM prompt-and-parse step could become a structured decision' (SKILL.md:8-10), which is not limited to tasks that already involve TypeSafe. Once loaded, the body recommends TypeSafe primitives (SKILL.md:95-117) while also saying to 'Preserve the user's chosen stack and scope' (SKILL.md:59-60).

Licensing: MIT covers this repo's files (LICENSE:1-21; skills/typesafe-ai/LICENSE; SKILL.md:3; .claude-plugin/plugin.json:11). The licensing and terms of the docs.typesafe.ai content the skill tells agents to read, and of the TypeSafe service and models, are not stated in the repo.
